rows.title: I Thought That I Could Get Away with It
Three Girl Rhumba
notes: “it's Bach Psychosis, a group that, yeah, post-rock group from London ... The album Game Over from 1997 and the track Three Girl Rumba”
Wire cover from the 1997 compilation Game Over (3rd Stone), originally recorded for the Wire tribute album Whore.

rows.title: We Don't Need Another Hero (Thunderdome) [Extended Version]
Let Me Show You How
notes: “i'm gonna play a track by michael peters now he um yeah just made this song as far as i know let me show you how um very special show wasn't ever really properly released”
Rare 1982 boogie-funk 12" that only exists as an unlabelled test pressing (matrix MP-848), never properly released; also played on Loose Joints in May 2025.

A Night With The Boys (Trail Of Destruction Dub)
Sick
notes: the audio briefly looked like Elio Riso & Lucio Spain - Breaking Minds, but the presenter said otherwise
A2 from Luis CL's 2016 debut 'Untitled' EP (SCR002) on Melbourne label Superconscious Records; Luis CL is also part of Zanzibar Chanel.

rows.title: Kotone
notes: “This is Jack Wickham, a track from, I think it was 2017 maybe, Cotone”
the audio briefly looked like Tanya Louise - Deep in You (Rob's Vibey Dub), but the presenter said otherwise
Title track of the 2017 vinyl-only Kotone EP (INFUSE019) on FUSE London's Infuse label, by Leeds producer Jack Wickham.
